page.overview:
What is Reva's lightsaber?

Reva's lightsaber also known as Reva's double-bladed Inquisitor Lightsaber, and the Third Sister's lightsaber, was a lightsaber wielded by the Jedi hunter known as the Third Sister, also known as Reva, during her service to the Galactic Empire. It was similar in appearance to other double-bladed spinning lightsabers wielded by Imperial Inquisitors. As the hunt for Obi-Wan Kenobi came to an end, Reva would lay down her lightsaber, seeking to turn her back on the dark side of the Force.

While many Inquisitors carried their lightsabers on their backs, the Third Sister kept hers hang on her right side. The saber was able to be split into two separate blades with the ringed emitter retracting at the sides so the hilt can extend and split apart. This allowed Reva to utilize her Jar'Kai skills, which she perfected under the Grand Inquisitor's tutelage. The saber's kyber crystals once belonged to Jedi who were killed during the Great Jedi Purge and were bled by Reva herself.

In 9 BBY, the Third Sister utilized the lightsaber during the Inquisitors' pursuit of the Jedi Nari, which led them to a saloon in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. When Nari attempted to escape, the Third Sister drew her lightsaber and struck at him, but the Grand Inquisitor used the Force to stop her blade, leaving only Nari's left shoulder injured. As Nari fled the scene, the Grand Inquisitor chastised the Third Sister for her recklessness to kill a Jedi he had planned to interrogate. As the Inquisitors searched for information on the Jedi's whereabouts, the Third Sister threatened to cut off the hands of those who would not speak, making example of a woman who claimed that the Galactic Empire had no authority over the Outer Rim Territories. The Third Sister then turned her attention to moisture farmer Owen Lars and threatened him with her lightsaber, but the Fifth Brother ordered her to stand down.

Later, the Third Sister would brandish her lightsaber on the planet Daiyu, where she had kidnapped Princess Leia Organa in order to lure Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi out of hiding. As she cornered Kenobi in a shipyard, the Third Sister was stopped by the Grand Inquisitor, who ordered her aside to avoid her losing their quarry. The Third Sister instead used her lightsaber to stab the Grand Inquisitor in the abdomen. Although Kenobi escaped with Organa, the Third Sister was able to capture the young princess on Mapuzo, bringing her to Fortress Inquisitorius on the moon Nur. She would then use her lightsaber to defend against an attack on the fortress, deflecting cannon fire from two T-47 airspeeders flown by members of the Hidden Path.
